name: stm32l053
description: ST STM32L053x8 (Cortex-M0+ 32 MHz, 64 KB flash, 8 KB SRAM, 2 KB EEPROM, segment LCD, USB FS, touch sensing, DAC, COMP1/2, RNG): GNU Arm toolchain with the STM32CubeL0 HAL/LL, Renode stm32l053 platform (boards NUCLEO-L053R8 and 32L0538DISCOVERY)

toolchain.notes: Link with a STM32L053R8Tx_FLASH.ld and startup_stm32l053xx.s from a Cube example (Projects/NUCLEO-L053R8/Templates/SW4STM32). Whole Cube examples build with tools/stm32cube/build_example.py in the Renode tree (sources, includes and defines from the example's SW4STM32 project).

image.notes: load the ELF; the vector table is at 0x08000000

renode.notes: Boards: platforms/boards/st/nucleo_l053r8.repl (LD2 PA5 = led2, B1 PC13 = sysbus.gpioPortC.userButton, active low, VCP usart2) and platforms/boards/st/stm32l0538_disco.repl (LED3 PB4 = led3, LED4 PA5 = led4, B1 PA0 = sysbus.gpioPortA.userButton). Analog: 'syscfg SetPinVoltage "PA1" 1.5' drives COMP1/COMP2 inputs (DAC on PA4 is read from the dac model). Touch: 'tsc Touch 1 2 true' (group, I/O), 'tsc SetCount 1 2 900'. LCD: 'lcd Dump' prints the shown segments per COM, 'lcd Segment 0 5'. RNG: 'rng InjectSeedError'. Timer clocks follow the RCC (SYSCLK, HPRE, PPRE1/PPRE2); TIM2/6/21 TRGO drives the DAC trigger inputs; DMA requests (USART TX/RX, TIM2 update and CC1-4, TIM6/DAC) reach the channel CSELR selects (dmaRouter). The 32L0538DISCOVERY board has the IDD-measurement MCU at I2C1 0x42 as a write-accepting stub. Test fixtures: tools/stm32cube/fixtures (e.g. lsi_tim21.repl feeds the LSI to TIM21 for the IWDG examples' LSI measurement); a microSD card for the Adafruit shield: platforms/boards/st/adafruit_shield_sd.repl. Pins: add 'pins: Miscellaneous.PinRecorder @ gpioPortA 0' and connections such as 'gpioPortA:' / '    5 -> led2@0 | pins@5' (a .repl file), then 'sysbus.gpioPortA.pins Edges 5'. Docs: tools/stm32cube/README.md.

reference.simulator: none; the models are checked with the STM32CubeL0 examples (tools/stm32cube/run_examples.py with examples_l053.txt in the Renode tree)
